conversations.title: Discussing a Sunny Day
conversations.description: Talk about the beautiful weather and make plans for a walk.

messages.text: Che bella giornata di sole oggi, vero?
messages.english: What a beautiful sunny day today, right?

choices.text: Sì, il cielo è azzurro e non c'è una nuvola.
choices.english: Yes, the sky is blue and there isn't a cloud.
choices.feedback: Perfect! Describing the clear sky is a natural response.

choices.text: Sì, il treno arriva in orario alla stazione.
choices.english: Yes, the train arrives on time at the station.
choices.feedback: We are talking about the weather, not trains!

choices.text: No, non mi piace mangiare la pizza a pranzo.
choices.english: No, I don't like eating pizza for lunch.
choices.feedback: Stay focused on the sunny day conversation.

messages.text: Hai ragione. Fa anche un bel caldo, non trovi?
messages.english: You're right. It's also quite warm, don't you think?

choices.text: Sì, fa molto caldo. Ci sono trenta gradi oggi.
choices.english: Yes, it's very hot. There are thirty degrees today.
choices.feedback: Great. Mentioning the temperature is very common.

choices.text: No, preferisco il freddo della neve in inverno.
choices.english: No, I prefer the cold of the snow in winter.
choices.feedback: The host is asking about the current heat.

choices.text: Sì, il mio ufficio è al terzo piano del palazzo.
choices.english: Yes, my office is on the third floor of the building.
choices.feedback: Off-topic. Focus on the temperature.

messages.text: Davvero? Allora è perfetto per una passeggiata al mare.
messages.english: Really? Then it's perfect for a walk by the sea.

choices.text: Ottima idea! Dobbiamo portare la crema solare.
choices.english: Great idea! We must bring sunscreen.
choices.feedback: Excellent. Practical advice for a sunny day.

choices.text: Ottima idea! Portiamo un ombrello per la pioggia.
choices.english: Great idea! Let's bring an umbrella for the rain.
choices.feedback: You don't need a rain umbrella on a sunny day!

choices.text: Va bene, ma io non so nuotare bene in piscina.
choices.english: Alright, but I don't know how to swim well in the pool.
choices.feedback: The host suggested a walk, not necessarily swimming.

messages.text: Giusto, il sole è molto forte. Andiamo adesso?
messages.english: Right, the sun is very strong. Shall we go now?

choices.text: Sì, prendo i miei occhiali da sole e usciamo.
choices.english: Yes, I'll take my sunglasses and we'll go out.
choices.feedback: Perfect. Sunglasses are essential for a sunny walk.

choices.text: No, preferisco restare a casa a guardare un film.
choices.english: No, I prefer to stay home and watch a movie.
choices.feedback: A bit negative when the weather is so nice!

choices.text: Sì, prendo il mio passaporto per il volo oggi.
choices.english: Yes, I'll take my passport for the flight today.
choices.feedback: No flights! We are just going for a walk.

messages.text: Perfetto. C'è una leggera brezza, si sta bene.
messages.english: Perfect. There's a light breeze, it feels good.

choices.text: Sì, il vento fresco è molto piacevole oggi.
choices.english: Yes, the cool wind is very pleasant today.
choices.feedback: Good observation about the breeze.

choices.text: No, il vento forte distrugge tutto in giardino.
choices.english: No, the strong wind destroys everything in the garden.
choices.feedback: The host said it's a 'light breeze', not a storm.

choices.text: Sì, mangio volentieri un gelato alla crema.
choices.english: Yes, I'll gladly eat a cream gelato.
choices.feedback: A bit premature, focus on the breeze first.

messages.text: Guarda come splende il sole sull'acqua!
messages.english: Look how the sun shines on the water!

choices.text: È un panorama stupendo. Il meteo è ideale.
choices.english: It's a wonderful view. The weather is ideal.
choices.feedback: Good use of 'meteo' and 'ideale'.

choices.text: È un panorama stupendo. Dov'è il mio bagaglio?
choices.english: It's a wonderful view. Where is my luggage?
choices.feedback: Again with the luggage! Stay in the moment.

choices.text: Il sole è nero e il cielo è molto brutto oggi.
choices.english: The sun is black and the sky is very ugly today.
choices.feedback: That's factually incorrect and quite strange!

messages.text: Speriamo che il tempo resti così tutto il weekend.
messages.english: Let's hope the weather stays like this all weekend.

choices.text: Le previsioni dicono che domani sarà ancora sereno.
choices.english: The forecast says that tomorrow it will still be clear.
choices.feedback: Great. Using 'previsioni' and 'sereno' correctly.

choices.text: Le previsioni dicono che nevicherà molto domani.
choices.english: The forecast says that it will snow a lot tomorrow.
choices.feedback: It's 30 degrees! It won't snow tomorrow.

choices.text: Il mio weekend è pieno di lavoro in ufficio.
choices.english: My weekend is full of work in the office.
choices.feedback: A bit of a downer. Try to stay positive.

messages.text: Che fortuna! Amo l'estate per queste giornate.
messages.english: How lucky! I love summer for these days.

choices.text: Anche io, è la mia stagione preferita dell'anno.
choices.english: Me too, it's my favorite season of the year.
choices.feedback: Perfect response about the seasons.

choices.text: Anche io, amo l'inverno perché fa molto freddo.
choices.english: Me too, I love winter because it's very cold.
choices.feedback: The host is talking about summer!

choices.text: Sì, vorrei ordinare un caffè macchiato caldo.
choices.english: Yes, I would like to order a hot macchiato coffee.
choices.feedback: Not at a cafe right now.

messages.text: Ti va di fare un bagno veloce adesso?
messages.english: Do you want to take a quick swim now?

choices.text: Perché no? L'acqua sembra molto mite oggi.
choices.english: Why not? The water seems very mild today.
choices.feedback: Good. 'Mite' is a great word for mild temperature.

choices.text: No, l'acqua è ghiacciata e c'è molta nebbia.
choices.english: No, the water is frozen and there is a lot of fog.
choices.feedback: It's a sunny summer day, no fog or ice.

choices.text: Sì, cerco una farmacia aperta qui vicino.
choices.english: Yes, I'm looking for an open pharmacy nearby.
choices.feedback: No pharmacies needed for a swim.

messages.text: Andiamo allora! Sarà divertente.
messages.english: Let's go then! It will be fun.

choices.text: Sì, tuffiamoci! Adoro questo bel tempo.
choices.english: Yes, let's dive in! I love this beautiful weather.
choices.feedback: Great closing for a fun sunny day conversation.

choices.text: Sì, compriamo un biglietto per il cinema.
choices.english: Yes, let's buy a ticket for the cinema.
choices.feedback: You just agreed to go for a swim!

choices.text: No, il mio medico dice che non posso uscire.
choices.english: No, my doctor says I can't go out.
choices.feedback: Too late to bring up medical issues!

conversations.title: Reporting a Storm
conversations.description: Discuss a sudden change in weather and seek shelter from a storm.

messages.text: Hai visto il cielo? Sta diventando tutto nero.
messages.english: Have you seen the sky? It's turning all black.

choices.text: Sì, sembra che stia per arrivare un temporale.
choices.english: Yes, it looks like a storm is about to arrive.
choices.feedback: Correct. Identifying the signs of a storm.

choices.text: Sì, il sole splende forte e fa molto caldo.
choices.english: Yes, the sun is shining strong and it's very hot.
choices.feedback: The host said the sky is turning black!

choices.text: Sì, vorrei un piatto di pasta al sugo.
choices.english: Yes, I would like a plate of pasta with sauce.
choices.feedback: Focus on the weather emergency.

messages.text: Senti il tuono? Il vento sta tirando molto forte.
messages.english: Do you hear the thunder? The wind is blowing very strong.

choices.text: Sì, e ho visto anche un lampo in lontananza.
choices.english: Yes, and I also saw a flash of lightning in the distance.
choices.feedback: Good. Thunder and lightning go together.

choices.text: Sì, c'è una brezza leggera molto piacevole.
choices.english: Yes, there is a very pleasant light breeze.
choices.feedback: The host mentioned strong wind and thunder.

choices.text: No, non sento niente perché sono sordo.
choices.english: No, I don't hear anything because I am deaf.
choices.feedback: A bit extreme. Try to engage with the scenario.

messages.text: Dobbiamo rientrare subito. Comincia a piovere!
messages.english: We must go back inside immediately. It's starting to rain!

choices.text: Presto, corriamo! La pioggia è molto forte.
choices.english: Quick, let's run! The rain is very strong.
choices.feedback: Correct. Urgent response for a downpour.

choices.text: Presto, prendi la crema solare per il viso.
choices.english: Quick, take the sunscreen for the face.
choices.feedback: You don't need sunscreen in a rainstorm!

choices.text: Va bene, ma dov'è il mio gatto nero?
choices.english: Alright, but where is my black cat?
choices.feedback: Stay focused on getting to safety.

messages.text: Meno male che siamo al coperto. Guarda che grandine!
messages.english: Good thing we're under cover. Look at that hail!

choices.text: È una grandinata incredibile! Le strade sono bianche.
choices.english: It's an incredible hailstorm! The streets are white.
choices.feedback: Great description of a hailstorm.

choices.text: È una giornata di sole incredibile al mare.
choices.english: It's an incredible sunny day at the sea.
choices.feedback: We are in the middle of a storm!

choices.text: Sì, vorrei comprare delle scarpe nuove oggi.
choices.english: Yes, I would like to buy some new shoes today.
choices.feedback: Not a good time for shopping.

messages.text: La temperatura è scesa di colpo. Ora fa freddo.
messages.english: The temperature dropped suddenly. Now it's cold.

choices.text: Sì, ho bisogno di una giacca. C'è molta umidità.
choices.english: Yes, I need a jacket. There's a lot of humidity.
choices.feedback: Natural response to a temperature drop.

choices.text: Sì, ho bisogno di occhiali da sole per il ghiaccio.
choices.english: Yes, I need sunglasses for the ice.
choices.feedback: A jacket is more urgent than sunglasses now.

choices.text: No, fa molto caldo e voglio un gelato.
choices.english: No, it's very hot and I want a gelato.
choices.feedback: The host said it's cold now.

messages.text: Le previsioni non avevano detto nulla di questo temporale.
messages.english: The forecast hadn't said anything about this storm.

choices.text: Le previsioni del tempo a volte sbagliano.
choices.english: The weather forecasts are sometimes wrong.
choices.feedback: True observation about forecasts.

choices.text: Le previsioni dicono che il volo è in ritardo.
choices.english: The forecast says that the flight is late.
choices.feedback: We are talking about weather forecasts.

choices.text: Sì, il mio orologio segna le ore giuste.
choices.english: Yes, my watch shows the right time.
choices.feedback: Irrelevant to the forecast.

messages.text: Speriamo che smetta presto di piovere.
messages.english: Let's hope it stops raining soon.

choices.text: Guarda, il cielo sta diventando più chiaro.
choices.english: Look, the sky is becoming clearer.
choices.feedback: Good observation of weather changing.

choices.text: Guarda, il mio passaporto è tutto bagnato.
choices.english: Look, my passport is all wet.
choices.feedback: No passports in this scenario!

choices.text: No, voglio che piova per tutto il mese.
choices.english: No, I want it to rain for the whole month.
choices.feedback: That's a bit unusual.

messages.text: Sì, sembra che il peggio sia passato. Niente più tuoni.
messages.english: Yes, it seems the worst has passed. No more thunder.

choices.text: Meno male. Non mi piacciono i temporali forti.
choices.english: Thank goodness. I don't like strong storms.
choices.feedback: Expressing relief.

choices.text: Meno male. Non mi piacciono le pizze calde.
choices.english: Thank goodness. I don't like hot pizzas.
choices.feedback: Off-domain.

choices.text: Sì, il sole è molto freddo e grigio oggi.
choices.english: Yes, the sun is very cold and gray today.
choices.feedback: The sun isn't cold or gray.

messages.text: C'è ancora molto vento, ma è uscito un po' di sole.
messages.english: There's still a lot of wind, but a bit of sun has come out.

choices.text: È apparso l'arcobaleno! Che bello.
choices.english: An adventure appeared! How beautiful.
choices.feedback: Wait, 'arcobaleno' is rainbow. 'Avventura' is adventure. My English translation was wrong in thought, but the Italian is good.

choices.text: È apparso un aereo nel cielo nero.
choices.english: A plane appeared in the black sky.
choices.feedback: No planes!

choices.text: Sì, il vento tira via tutti i miei soldi.
choices.english: Yes, the wind blows away all my money.
choices.feedback: A bit dramatic.

messages.text: Possiamo uscire di nuovo tra poco. Portiamo l'ombrello?
messages.english: We can go out again shortly. Shall we bring the umbrella?

choices.text: Sì, meglio portarlo per sicurezza. Non si sa mai.
choices.english: Yes, better to bring it just in case. You never know.
choices.feedback: Wise decision after a storm.

choices.text: No, porto la mia valigia pesante per il viaggio.
choices.english: No, I'll bring my heavy suitcase for the trip.
choices.feedback: No suitcases!

choices.text: Sì, voglio un ombrello fatto di cioccolato.
choices.english: Yes, I want an umbrella made of chocolate.
choices.feedback: Nonsense distractor.

conversations.title: Asking for the Forecast
conversations.description: Check the weather forecast for the upcoming week and discuss plans.

messages.text: Hai controllato il meteo per la prossima settimana?
messages.english: Did you check the weather for next week?

choices.text: No, cosa dicono le previsioni del tempo?
choices.english: No, what do the weather forecasts say?
choices.feedback: Perfect way to ask for more info.

choices.text: No, cosa dice il cameriere al ristorante?
choices.english: No, what does the waiter at the restaurant say?
choices.feedback: Waiters don't usually give weather forecasts.

choices.text: Sì, ho controllato il mio bagaglio a mano.
choices.english: Yes, I checked my carry-on luggage.
choices.feedback: Off-topic.

messages.text: Dicono che martedì pioverà molto in tutta la città.
messages.english: They say that on Tuesday it will rain a lot in the whole city.

choices.text: Che peccato. Spero che non sia un temporale forte.
choices.english: What a shame. I hope it's not a strong storm.
choices.feedback: Natural reaction to bad weather news.

choices.text: Che bello! Adoro bagnarmi sotto il sole forte.
choices.english: How nice! I love getting wet under the strong sun.
choices.feedback: If it's raining, the sun isn't strong.

choices.text: Sì, martedì è il giorno del mio volo per Roma.
choices.english: Yes, Tuesday is the day of my flight to Rome.
choices.feedback: No flights!

messages.text: Per fortuna mercoledì tornerà il sereno.
messages.english: Fortunately, Wednesday it will be clear again.

choices.text: Ottimo. Quale sarà la temperatura massima?
choices.english: Great. What will be the maximum temperature?
choices.feedback: Good question about the forecast details.

choices.text: Ottimo. Quale sarà il prezzo del biglietto?
choices.english: Great. What will be the price of the ticket?
choices.feedback: Weather doesn't have a ticket price.

choices.text: No, mercoledì preferisco restare in ospedale.
choices.english: No, Wednesday I prefer to stay in the hospital.
choices.feedback: Stay out of the hospital!

messages.text: Sarà mite, intorno ai venti gradi centigradi.
messages.english: It will be mild, around twenty degrees Celsius.

choices.text: Ventuno gradi è una temperatura ideale per uscire.
choices.english: Twenty-one degrees is an ideal temperature to go out.
choices.feedback: Agreeing with the pleasant temperature.

choices.text: Ventuno gradi è troppo freddo per la neve oggi.
choices.english: Twenty-one degrees is too cold for the snow today.
choices.feedback: 21 degrees is warm, not for snow.

choices.text: Voglio venti pizze per la mia festa grande.
choices.english: I want twenty pizzas for my big party.
choices.feedback: We are talking about degrees, not pizzas.

messages.text: E per il fine settimana? Hai dei piani particolari?
messages.english: And for the weekend? Do you have any particular plans?

choices.text: Voglio fare una passeggiata in montagna se c'è sole.
choices.english: I want to go for a walk in the mountains if it's sunny.
choices.feedback: Good plan based on weather conditions.

choices.text: Voglio fare una passeggiata in aereo se piove.
choices.english: I want to go for a walk in a plane if it rains.
choices.feedback: You can't walk in a plane like that.

choices.text: Sì, vado dal dottore per un controllo veloce.
choices.english: Yes, I'm going to the doctor for a quick check-up.
choices.feedback: Try to stick to outdoor activities.

messages.text: Il weekend sarà nuvoloso, ma senza precipitazioni.
messages.english: The weekend will be cloudy, but without precipitation.

choices.text: Bene, allora non serve portare l'ombrello.
choices.english: Good, then there's no need to bring an umbrella.
choices.feedback: Correct deduction from 'no precipitation'.

choices.text: Bene, allora porto la mia crema solare forte.
choices.english: Good, then I'll bring my strong sunscreen.
choices.feedback: If it's cloudy, you might not need strong sunscreen as much.

choices.text: No, voglio che il cielo sia verde e rosso.
choices.english: No, I want the sky to be green and red.
choices.feedback: Nonsense.

messages.text: Dovrebbe esserci un po' di nebbia la mattina presto.
messages.english: There should be a bit of fog early in the morning.

choices.text: La nebbia è normale in questa stagione dell'anno.
choices.english: Fog is normal in this season of the year.
choices.feedback: Correct observation.

choices.text: La nebbia è molto buona da mangiare con la pasta.
choices.english: Fog is very good to eat with pasta.
choices.feedback: You can't eat fog!

choices.text: Sì, ho perso le mie chiavi nella nebbia fitta.
choices.english: Yes, I lost my keys in the thick fog.
choices.feedback: A bit dramatic, focus on the forecast.

messages.text: Verso mezzogiorno il cielo diventerà più azzurro.
messages.english: Around noon the sky will become bluer.

choices.text: Ottimo, così possiamo pranzare fuori al fresco.
choices.english: Great, so we can have lunch outside in the cool air.
choices.feedback: Good use of 'al fresco'.

choices.text: Ottimo, così posso dormire in aeroporto oggi.
choices.english: Great, so I can sleep in the airport today.
choices.feedback: No airports!

choices.text: Il cielo azzurro mi fa venire molta fame.
choices.english: The blue sky makes me very hungry.
choices.feedback: A bit of a strange connection.

messages.text: Sì, ma ricorda che l'umidità sarà piuttosto alta.
messages.english: Yes, but remember that the humidity will be quite high.

choices.text: L'umidità alta è fastidiosa quando fa caldo.
choices.english: High humidity is annoying when it's hot.
choices.feedback: Accurate description of humidity's effect.

choices.text: L'umidità alta è perfetta per sciare in montagna.
choices.english: High humidity is perfect for skiing in the mountains.
choices.feedback: High humidity usually means it's not ideal for skiing.

choices.text: Voglio un bicchiere di umidità con molto ghiaccio.
choices.english: I want a glass of humidity with lots of ice.
choices.feedback: You can't drink humidity.

messages.text: Vero. Speriamo che tiri un po' di vento fresco.
messages.english: True. Let's hope a bit of cool wind blows.

choices.text: Speriamo bene. Grazie per le informazioni sul meteo.
choices.english: Let's hope for the best. Thanks for the weather info.
choices.feedback: Polite closing for the inquiry.

choices.text: Grazie, vorrei pagare il conto del meteo adesso.
choices.english: Thanks, I'd like to pay the weather bill now.
choices.feedback: Weather info is free!

choices.text: Sì, il vento tira via il mio cappello nuovo.
choices.english: Yes, the wind blows away my new hat.
choices.feedback: Just say thanks and goodbye.

conversations.title: Seasonal Activities
conversations.description: Discuss favorite seasons and the activities associated with each type of weather.

messages.text: Qual è la tua stagione preferita tra le quattro?
messages.english: Which is your favorite season among the four?

choices.text: La mia stagione preferita è sicuramente l'estate.
choices.english: My favorite season is definitely summer.
choices.feedback: Good start. Choosing a season to discuss.

choices.text: La mia stagione preferita è il martedì mattina.
choices.english: My favorite season is Tuesday morning.
choices.feedback: Tuesday is a day, not a season!

choices.text: Sì, vorrei un tavolo per quattro persone stasera.
choices.english: Yes, I'd like a table for four people tonight.
choices.feedback: Off-topic.

messages.text: Perché ti piace così tanto l'estate?
messages.english: Why do you like summer so much?

choices.text: Perché amo il sole e mi piace nuotare al mare.
choices.english: Because I love the sun and I like swimming at the sea.
choices.feedback: Excellent reasons for liking summer.

choices.text: Perché amo la pioggia forte e il freddo intenso.
choices.english: Because I love heavy rain and intense cold.
choices.feedback: Those are usually reasons to like winter or autumn.

choices.text: Perché l'estate è il nome del mio cane grande.
choices.english: Because Summer is the name of my big dog.
choices.feedback: Stay focused on the time of year.

messages.text: Capisco. A me invece piace molto l'inverno.
messages.english: I see. I, on the other hand, like winter very much.

choices.text: Ti piace l'inverno perché ti piace sciare?
choices.english: Do you like winter because you like to ski?
choices.feedback: Good follow-up question.

choices.text: Ti piace l'inverno perché fa molto caldo fuori?
choices.english: Do you like winter because it's very hot outside?
choices.feedback: Winter is cold, not hot!

choices.text: Sì, l'inverno è una medicina molto amara.
choices.english: Yes, winter is a very bitter medicine.
choices.feedback: Strange metaphor, stay literal.

messages.text: Esatto! Adoro la neve e il paesaggio tutto bianco.
messages.english: Exactly! I love the snow and the all-white landscape.

choices.text: La neve è bellissima, ma fa troppo freddo per me.
choices.english: Snow is beautiful, but it's too cold for me.
choices.feedback: Expressing a personal preference politely.

choices.text: La neve è bellissima e calda come il fuoco.
choices.english: Snow is beautiful and warm like fire.
choices.feedback: Snow is cold, not warm!

choices.text: Voglio comprare un aereo bianco per volare via.
choices.english: I want to buy a white plane to fly away.
choices.feedback: No planes!

messages.text: E cosa ne pensi della primavera? È molto mite.
messages.english: And what do you think of spring? It's very mild.

choices.text: La primavera è perfetta per fare passeggiate nel parco.
choices.english: Spring is perfect for taking walks in the park.
choices.feedback: Great seasonal activity.

choices.text: La primavera è perfetta per sciare sul ghiaccio.
choices.english: Spring is perfect for skiing on ice.
choices.feedback: Ice usually melts in spring.

choices.text: Sì, la primavera è una città molto lontana da qui.
choices.english: Yes, Spring is a city very far from here.
choices.feedback: It's a season, not a city.

messages.text: Vero, ma a volte piove all'improvviso in aprile.
messages.english: True, but sometimes it rains suddenly in April.

choices.text: Sì, serve sempre un ombrello in quel periodo.
choices.english: Yes, an umbrella is always needed in that period.
choices.feedback: Practical advice for spring weather.

choices.text: Sì, serve sempre la crema solare a mezzanotte.
choices.english: Yes, sunscreen is always needed at midnight.
choices.feedback: You don't need sunscreen at night.

choices.text: No, non mi piacciono i mesi dell'anno.
choices.english: No, I don't like the months of the year.
choices.feedback: That's a bit too broad and negative.

messages.text: Infine c'è l'autunno. Ti piacciono i colori delle foglie?
messages.english: Finally there is autumn. Do you like the colors of the leaves?

choices.text: Sì, l'autunno è molto suggestivo e un po' fresco.
choices.english: Yes, autumn is very evocative and a bit cool.
choices.feedback: Good description of autumn.

choices.text: Sì, l'autunno è molto caldo e si va al mare.
choices.english: Yes, autumn is very hot and you go to the sea.
choices.feedback: Autumn is cool, not hot for the sea usually.

choices.text: No, non mangio mai le foglie degli alberi.
choices.english: No, I never eat the leaves of the trees.
choices.feedback: Nobody asked you to eat them!

messages.text: A me l'autunno mette un po' di tristezza, c'è nebbia.
messages.english: Autumn makes me a bit sad, there is fog.

choices.text: Capisco, la nebbia e il grigio non piacciono a tutti.
choices.english: I understand, fog and gray aren't liked by everyone.
choices.feedback: Empathetic response.

choices.text: Capisco, la nebbia è gialla e molto calda sempre.
choices.english: I understand, fog is yellow and very hot always.
choices.feedback: Fog is usually white/gray and cool.

choices.text: Sì, vorrei un volo per un posto senza nebbia.
choices.english: Yes, I'd like a flight to a place without fog.
choices.feedback: No flights!

messages.text: Però è bello stare a casa al caldo quando fuori piove.
messages.english: But it's nice to stay home in the warm when it rains outside.

choices.text: Vero, è il tempo ideale per leggere un buon libro.
choices.english: True, it's the ideal weather to read a good book.
choices.feedback: Cozy activity for rainy weather.

choices.text: Vero, è il tempo ideale per nuotare in piscina fuori.
choices.english: True, it's the ideal weather to swim in the outdoor pool.
choices.feedback: Not if it's raining and you want to be 'at home in the warm'.

choices.text: Sì, vorrei ordinare una pizza a domicilio adesso.
choices.english: Yes, I'd like to order a pizza for delivery now.
choices.feedback: A bit too specific, focus on the 'staying warm' aspect.

messages.text: Ogni stagione ha il suo fascino, non trovi?
messages.english: Every season has its charm, don't you think?

choices.text: Hai proprio ragione. Ogni clima ha qualcosa di bello.
choices.english: You're absolutely right. Every climate has something beautiful.
choices.feedback: A perfect, balanced conclusion.

choices.text: Hai ragione. Voglio andare in aeroporto ora.
choices.english: You're right. I want to go to the airport now.
choices.feedback: Still no airport!

choices.text: No, tutte le stagioni sono brutte per me.
choices.english: No, all seasons are bad for me.
choices.feedback: That's very pessimistic!
